responsibility: Specializes the PA HP-UX 11 configuration for HP-UX 11i v1 (11.11). It identifies the target as supporting the 11.11 feature set and refines STARTFILE_SPEC so startup object selection distinguishes UNIX 93, UNIX 95, and UNIX 98 modes, adding the 11i multibyte/UNIX 98 startup behavior on top of pa-hpux11.h.
same_name_distinction: HP-UX 11.11 target header that enables TARGET_HPUX_11_11 and selects startup objects for UNIX 93/95/98 modes; unlike pa-hpux1111.opt, it contains the OS-version-specific STARTFILE_SPEC logic rather than just the option declaration.
